title: Drawn-challenge admission: sealed per-axis corpus + stratified sampling rule (A8, H26-10)
question: Are scores commensurable when validators draw from a sealed corpus, and does validator authorship demonstrably break commensurability?
m308a_note: run 1 VOIDED on its own C2 bound: the drawn-score gap 0.025 sat above the registered tolerance 0.02 with draw_count 40. M308a calibrated from the instrument's own sampling resolution (100 seeded reps per draw count, before any change): gap median/p95/max 0.025/0.101/0.175 at 40, 0.0125/0.030/0.04 at 400, 0.0028/0.0072/0.0145 at 6400. draw_count 40->6400 and population_rows 6000->24000 (the stratified rule needs 1600 per class without replacement); tolerance unchanged and now above the instrument's measured worst gap. Run-1 evidence stays on record as evidence_void_c2.json.

registered_notes.drawn: R-A8: validators draw from a registered sealed per-axis corpus under a published stratified rule; they sample, pose, verify, attest - never choose the exam
registered_notes.score: the routable score is the fraction correct over drawn challenges: an estimate of ONE fixed population quantity
registered_notes.authored: validator-authored challenges remain as a supplementary stream, reported separately, never entering the routable score
registered_notes.h26_10: scores for the same artifact by disjoint validator sets agree within tolerance under drawn challenges and violate it under authored ones

interpretation_registered_before_running.c1_fails: the draw is not stratified per the registered rule or does not rotate - the sampling rule is not the published one; VOID
interpretation_registered_before_running.c2_fails: disjoint validator sets disagree beyond tolerance on the same artifact - drawn scores are not commensurable either; VOID
interpretation_registered_before_running.c3_fails: authored challenges do NOT produce disagreement - the defect A8 claims would not be demonstrated; VOID
interpretation_registered_before_running.c4_fails: authored challenges change the routable score - the supplementary stream leaks into scoring; VOID
interpretation_registered_before_running.all_hold: M308 PASS: drawn challenges are commensurable (H26-10) and authoring is demonstrably not
